exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: existing game diffuse texture, faithful subtle HD painted refinement. Preserve the original bitmap material and UV layout, never render/photograph a replacement object.

Only input is ENTIRE original storedRGB opaque nearest guide; same complete source aspect and normalized canvas required. Keep all source fields, part/paint count, faint local marks, source scale and irregular soft edges. No crop, zoom, margin, padding, auto-fitting or moving sections.

Native64x32, sourceRGB NN8x512x256. Preserve exactly four original visible paint fields: large left irregular fine-grain gray field, lower-middle soft brown field, small lower-right fine-grain gray field, and upper-right wide darkbrown field. The upper field has EXACTLY TWO existing light tonal bands with native row peaks y1 and4 inside x29..62,y0..11 (prominence>5); preserve their original strength/phase and never add extra stripes/rings. Keep original gray fine pigment stipple at exact source scale/positions, broad brown soft shading, all original black gaps. Do not turn grain or brown shading into rocks/stones/pores/chunks/a new circular beveled object, no new spots or creases.

Material and light: original subdued palette and soft source paint/wash. Add ONLY extremely subtle finer painted detail compatible with current fine source surface, keeping original broad shading and local light hierarchy. No newly invented photograin, relief, gloss, bright rims/bevels, tubes/rods/collars, grooves/threads, fabric weave, rust, wood pattern, dirt/crack geometry or new regular grid. Do not lighten original black UV or sharpen source pale paint; do not enlarge faint stains or generate text from them.

Constraints: preserve exact original shapes/count/positions/phase, every tiny light/dark source mark and component. No added/removed hole/line/tab/fastener/symbol/letter/number. Entire opaque RGB texture canvas only; engine restores full original native source alpha separately. Fine source softness retained, no new object perspective/depth/background/logo.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
